svg.title: PCA variance shares depend on measurement scale
svg.desc: Four points at plus or minus 100 for x and plus or minus one for y have zero covariance. Raw variance ratio is 10000 to one, so PC1 explains 99.99 percent. Standardization gives the identity covariance matrix, eigenvalues one and one, and tied 50 percent shares.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(98%,98%,96%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: A dominant component can come from scale
Four observations; zero covariance. Same data, two variance criteria.
